name: Caleb Smith II

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Elizabeth, daughter of Aaron Smith 2d; children Sarah (Mrs Maj. Ebenezer Smith), Martha (Mrs Thomas Mills), Elizabeth (Mrs Richard Blydenburgh), Caleb 3.

bioAdditions: His wife Elizabeth, daughter of Aaron Smith 2d, was presumably a granddaughter of Aaron Smith (son of Job 1st), which would make his children John's cousins through Job Smith as well; Aaron 2d's parentage was not checked.

sources.citation: W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix (archive.org full text, scans recordsoftownofs00smitrich and recordstownsmit00pellgoog), App. p. 477

researchLogEntry: Round 4: exact dates and marriage to Elizabeth dau. of Aaron Smith 2d from Pelletreau.
